what: loader: Water fills the screen while bubbles rise. The first line of the traced wordmark drops in letter by letter at 70ms intervals and wobbles (.72s cubic-bezier(.22,1.2,.36,1)), and the last line’s letters enter from off the right edge riding a wave (amplitude 11→4, tilt −7°→0) over 1.4s power3.out and settle. After three droplets spring from the first letter, it waits up to 2.2s for fonts and images, then the water level drains −.03→.012 (.25 sine.inOut)→1.08 (1.2s power3.inOut). The edge is a 40-step polygon layering three waves at frequencies 1.2·2.7·4.6, and the waves grow and slosh side to side as the drain speeds up. When the water passes under the letters they rise 4% and settle with elastic, and droplets splash. page: Clicking a same-site link scales the page to .95 with a 4px blur over .6s, then .25s later water rises 1.12→−.12 over .85s power2.inOut to cover it before navigating. On the new page the water drains −.12→1.12 over 1.05s while the page returns to place over .9s after .35s

options.letters: loader — wordmark letter css to imitate (e.g. .wordmark [data-fx-part=char]). If absent, only the color fades out
options.ride: loader — which letter the wave starts from, default is the letters on the bottom line
options.held: loader — class added to html while the water drains (when hiding the real wordmark), default wordmark-held
options.stage: page — CSS for the page wrapper that blurs and shrinks
options.delay: page — time from press until the water rises (sec), default .25

note: The loader adds is-loading and preloader-open to html, removes them when done, adds wordmark-placed, then fires kf:ready (the title pop-up part waits for it). Pages entered via a transition skip the loader. The original Next router transition was changed to a transition that opens the page fresh
